summary: Ran 21 pytest backend tests (100% pass) covering brands, reference-entries CRUD + admin gating, auth (with/without Bearer), settings admin gating, scan lifecycle including inactive-brand 400, uploads + file serve, photo/description persistence, AI analyze (real Unsplash watch JPEG) with free-tier gating (locked=true; value/story/authenticity/breakdown/references absent), Stripe checkout + status. Ran Playwright frontend suite covering landing, protected redirects, login, dashboard, brand select (Omega active, Rolex/Patek/AP disabled), scan wizard (7 slots, 4 required, continue disabled until met), admin gating (non-admin redirected, admin sees seeded rows), Add-Entry modal. Frontend has one CRITICAL UX bug: modal inputs lose focus after 1 keystroke.

ui_bugs.issue: The `F` helper component is defined INSIDE EntryModal, so React re-creates its component identity on every render. Typing any character causes the input to unmount/remount and lose focus. Result: user can only type 1 character at a time in model_family, reference_numbers, serial_range_start/end, production_period, case_material, movement_caliber, dial_variants, source_notes. Verified: after typing 'TEST_focus' the input value is only 'T' and document.activeElement becomes body.
ui_bugs.selector: [data-testid="entry-field-model_family"] and all other entry-field-* fields rendered via <F />

action_items: Fix Admin.jsx EntryModal: move the `F` component out of EntryModal (define it at module scope, or replace with inline <input> markup like the notable_history textarea). This is required for admins to add/edit reference entries at all.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx: `F` component defined inside EntryModal — causes remounting/focus-loss on every keystroke. Move to module scope.
backend/server.py uses deprecated FastAPI `@app.on_event('startup'|'shutdown')`; consider lifespan handlers (non-blocking, works).
STORAGE_BASE default 'https://integrations.emergentagent.com' is hardcoded fallback; acceptable but INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL env is not set — noted.
/api/files/{file_id} is publicly readable (no auth). Fine for MVP thumbnails but note: any user knowing a file_id can retrieve another user's photo.
free_result_view leaks confidence_percentage which is fine but ensure paid=false path also strips scan.result on GET (already does via free_result_view — verified).
get_scan uses model_copy() then reassigns scan.result — Pydantic v2 model_copy shallow copy is fine, works.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (12/13 flows; 1 critical bug: modal input focus loss)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Only remaining fix: Admin.jsx modal focus-loss (move `F` out of EntryModal). After fix, re-run Playwright typing test on [data-testid=entry-field-model_family] — activeElement should stay on that field after 5+ keystrokes and full string should land in input value. Fresh tokens can be provisioned via _provision_tokens() in backend_test.py.
rca of the issue: Admin.jsx line ~170: `const F = ({...}) => (...)` is declared inside EntryModal's function body. Every parent state change (setForm on keystroke) re-runs EntryModal, producing a NEW `F` function reference each render. React's diffing sees a different component type and unmounts the previous input, remounting a fresh one — which cannot inherit the previous focus. Fix: move `F` (and Field-style helpers) to module scope, or inline the input JSX directly. Reproduction: /admin (admin cookie) → Add Entry → click Model family → type 'ABC' → only 'A' is recorded and focus jumps to <body>.
